## bizOS CI / deploy failure webhook

Path: `POST /webhook/bizos/ci-failure`

Set `BIZOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in n8n env to match GitHub secret `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

GitHub Actions posts here when `N8N_CI_WEBHOOK_URL` is configured. For localhost-only n8n, prefer **bizOS GitHub Actions Poll** (no inbound webhook required).

Replace **Log Route** with Slack/email before activation.

meta.description: Sanitized template for CI/deploy failure notifications. active: false until ops review.
